fields.name: summary
fields.label: Lead paragraph
fields.description: One or two sentences shown under the headline, on the archive page and in the email.

fields.name: edition
fields.label: Edition label
fields.description: Optional, shown in the masthead. For example "Vol. 1 · No. 4" or "Fall 2026".

fields.name: meetingDate
fields.label: Board meeting date
fields.description: The board meeting this issue reports on.

fields.name: published
fields.label: Published
fields.description: Unpublished issues are hidden from the public site. Leave this off while drafting.

fields.name: sendEmail
fields.label: Email this issue to subscribers
fields.description: When this and "Published" are both on, the issue is emailed to confirmed subscribers on the next deploy. Each issue is only emailed once.

fields.name: image
fields.label: Front-page photo
fields.description: Optional. A landscape photo works best.

fields.name: category
fields.label: Category
fields.description: A short label above the headline, e.g. Maintenance, Finance, Building.

fields.name: deadline
fields.label: Feedback deadline
fields.description: Comments close automatically after this date.

fields.name: commentsEnabled
fields.label: Accept owner comments
fields.description: Shows a comment form. Comments appear publicly only after an admin approves them under "Owner Comments".

fields.name: wordLimit
fields.label: Comment word limit
fields.description: Maximum words per comment. Defaults to 300.

fields.name: boardReply
fields.label: Board reply (optional)
fields.description: Shown under the comment once it is approved.
